units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 69b:1">B. Bath. 69ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 23:17">Gen. XXIII, 17</cite>) <he>מי שצריך לג׳ סביב</he> such trees as require boundaries (small trees, are included in the sale).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 24b:10">Ab. Zar. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ יש לה</he> this assertion (<he>לוקחין מהן בהמה לקרבן</he>, <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 23b">ib. 23ᵇ</cite>) must be qualified.
Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᵇ top (ref. to Is. XXVIII, 25) ע״כ גְּבוּלוֹ של לחם so far goes the definition of bread, i.e. only these species can be called leḥem.

senses.gloss: (in gen.) country, contrad. to the sanctuary (מקדש) and Jerusalem.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 24b">Keth. 24ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>קדשי הג׳</he> the sacred gifts (T’rumah &c.) set apart and consumed outside of the Temple and Jerusalem.—Pl. <he>גְּבוּלִים</he>, <he>גְּבוּלִין</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 56a:7">B. Bath. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>עיירות העומדות על הג׳</he> border-towns.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 7:3">Shek. VII, 3</cite> <he>נמצא בג׳</he> if found outside of Jerusalem.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 30a">R. Hash. 30ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="C00283"><he>גּוֹבֶל</he></cite>.
